version: Closed helmet and integrated ivory docking base; replaces the previous open-visor report.

sampling.method: Bind pose plus 17 equally spaced samples in each original clip.
sampling.engine: Three.js 185 CPU skinning; Blender BVH surface queries.

closedEnclosure.onlyBoundary: 64-point neck loop at z=0.515, coupled to the skinned docking base. Rear and crown have no opening.

dockingBase.design: wide ivory docking footing z .476-.501; compact graphite neck band z .501-.515
dockingBase.lowerInfluenceMethod: source barycentric Shoulder/Arm/Hand weights folded into nearest torso ancestor, preserving inherited torso motion

surfaceContact.interpretation: The footing is deliberately implanted into the shirt volume; exact zero distance to its visible surface is neither required nor asserted.

backpack.previousResult: No body surface crossings. Geometry check reused because exact asset hash and original source/poses are unchanged.

limitations: This samples 103 poses; it is not a proof for every continuous-time pose, animation blend, or future clip.
The lower contact query uses the actual animated shirt shoulder triangles and local surface normals; it supplements visual inspection rather than proving visibility from every camera.
The CPU check does not render materials or decode textures. Leaf clearance is vertex-to-triangle sampling, not an exact continuous global minimum.
